summary.text: Pat Long is a Democratic state senator from New Hampshire who has represented District 20 since December 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as union ironworker.

paragraphs.text: Patrick Long attended Manchester West High School, and his career experience includes working as a union ironworker.
He has served as the mayor and alderman of Manchester, New Hampshire, on the Manchester School Board, and on the Manchester Planning Board.
Long served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives from 2006 to 2024, including Hillsborough 10 and Hillsborough 42, and on the Manchester Board of School Committee from 2018 to 2020.
He assumed office in the State Senate on December 4, 2024, and in the 2025-2026 session serves on the Children and Family Law Committee and the Health and Human Services Committee.
